method.aggregation: Median/min/max/range of each run mean, median, P95 and P99; runs equally weighted.
method.missing_gpu_passes: Reported as missing, never filled with zero.
method.source_integrity: run success, exact summary configuration, CSV SHA-256, applied variant and owned launch identity/hashes checked when present.
method.label_alias: CurrentBaseline* is included in Baseline; unknown non-trace labels excluded.
method.trace_policy: Trace runs require native start/connection/stop and a physical nonempty file; never pooled with non-trace runs.
method.legacy_policy: Missing launch manifests remain separate legacy-provisional groups; never pooled with verified owned launches.

limitations: GPU passes may be nested/overlapping; do not sum them as independent costs.
Traffic-off changes simulation, instance updates and dynamic render/shadow work together.
Random traffic and startup phase can differ; use repeated comparable runs.
These uncapped local render timings do not measure Pixel Streaming latency or remote FPS.
